A [[Gender|male]] [[human]] '''student''' attended a school on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]], where his [[Blue macaron|cookies]] was once stolen by the [[Mandalorian]] [[foundling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]].<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Biography==
A [[Youngling|young]] [[Gender|male]] student was attending a class on astrography when the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] and his entourage left his [[foundling]], [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], in the school, seating him beside the student. The student was snacking on a packet of [[Color|blue]] [[Blue macaron|cookies]], which Grogu took an interest in, seemingly requesting that the student share. After refusing to share some, the student found that the entirety of his [[Foodstuff|snack]] had been stolen by Grogu, who began to eat a cookie. The foundling took the sleeve of remaining cookies with him when Djarin returned for him sometime later.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Behind the scenes==
The student first appeared in "[[Chapter 12: The Siege]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Chapter 12" /> on [[November 20]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}}</ref> He was played by [[Daniel Negrete]] and credited as "School Kid."<ref name="Chapter 12" />
